name: Nullboard
tagline: The board is the file. One invite is the room — no Trello account.
description:
Close it, come back, or hand someone the GIF — the same lists are there. Press Invite in the bar above so a friend lands on this board with you. No account, no cloud, no Trello.

A column of notes is a list. A set of lists is a board. Click a note to type; click outside (or Shift-Enter) when you are done. Drag notes between lists. Hover ≡ — or tap it on a phone — for delete, raw look, and collapse. Ctrl-Z / Ctrl-Y walk the last fifty revisions.

On a phone the lists swipe sideways and + Note / + List / Undo / Boards sit under your thumbs.

An unofficial port of Nullboard by Alexander Pankratov. Same compact board, now a file you can keep and a room you can share.
